summary: Build robust curriculum QA systems and prepare programs for accreditation with practical tools, maps, and evidence frameworks. Enroll your team today.
lede: Curriculum quality assurance helps education and training professionals check that program outcomes, course content and assessments form a coherent, reviewable whole. For quality managers, program directors, curriculum designers and accreditation coordinators, the course covers curriculum mapping, outcomes–assessment alignment, program review planning and organizing evidence for accreditation.
audienceIntro: This training is tailored for education and training professionals who carry direct responsibility for curriculum quality, program coherence, and accreditation readiness across academic, professional, and corporate learning environments.
modules: Program Review Cycles and Internal Audits
Leveraging Quality Matters and Online Course Standards
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level program designed for professionals already working with academic programs or training portfolios. You should have: (1) basic familiarity with program or course documentation such as syllabi, learning outcomes, and assessment plans; (2) experience participating in at least one internal review, evaluation, or accreditation-related activity, even informally; and (3) the ability to interpret institutional policies on teaching, learning, and assessment. No coding or advanced statistics are required. All advanced topics such as use of AI-assisted analytics for curriculum review are taught at operational application level, focusing on how to commission, interpret, and apply results rather than how to build technical tools.
